method.prompt: Photorealistic back in the same narrow alley corner between two dark brick houses at night, snow piled against the walls, a single dim street lamp glowing, the same night, moments later, a barefoot girl of about nine with reddish-gold hair under a patched gray coat, clutching a bundle of matchboxes looks at the last matches, then at the sky where the star fell, and presses the whole bundle together with sudden resolve. Close-up on eyes. Heartbeat rising, matchbox shake, resolve breath.
